stem: A schedule maximizes flowering-room occupancy but creates harvest peaks that exceed trimming and dry-room capacity every third cycle. What is the strongest planning correction?
choices: Balance upstream room utilization with downstream labor and postharvest capacity instead of optimizing flowering occupancy alone
Ignore the downstream bottleneck because flowering drives yield
Move harvest dates without considering maturity
rationale: A crop plan is a linked production system. Optimizing one stage can reduce overall performance when downstream capacity becomes the bottleneck.
